node.label: Pseudoepiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand
node.definition: A secondary ossification center in the proximal phalanges of the hand that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.

evidence.snippet: Carpenter syndrome 1: Pseudoepiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand [PCS]
